programs.stacking_rules: Can stack with utility custom incentives and federal tax credits
programs.rebate_payment_method: Check or Instant Discount at distributor
programs.program_notes_ai: Effective Jan 1 2024 PSE increased rebate rates for commercial LED and lighting control projects. Midstream delivery via participating distributors for eligible products; downstream rebate application available for non-midstream purchases. DLC listing required for all fixtures and controls.

programs.rebate_payment_method: Check or Instant Discount at distributor
programs.program_notes_ai: Includes heat pumps, VRF systems, controls, water heating, and more. PSE Midstream HVAC+ delivers instant discounts through participating HVAC distributors. Includes commercial and residential end-use.

programs.stacking_rules: Equipment purchased in 2025 eligible for 2024 rebate amounts; equipment purchased on/after 1/1/2026 eligible for 2026 rates
programs.rebate_payment_method: Check or Instant Rebate at participating distributor
programs.program_notes_ai: Instant rebates available through participating local and national distributors. Must be a current PSE electric customer. Kitchen equipment can account for up to 75% of a business's energy use.

programs.program_name: PSE Small Business Energy Efficiency Program (2025)
programs.program_notes_ai: PSE team visits communities to conduct energy efficiency surveys and install free or low-cost energy solutions for small businesses. Small and medium-sized farms qualify. PSE Recommended Energy Professional (REP) network available for contractor referrals.

Tailored grants for retrofits and upgrades in energy-intensive buildings. Engineering consultation provided. Programs include HVAC, building controls, compressed air, motors, and more. Pre-approval required before project start.

programs.stacking_rules: Rebates may not exceed 70% of project costs; one incentive per address for HVAC/water heating with case-by-case exceptions
programs.program_notes_ai: Equipment installation cannot begin and products shall not be purchased until project is reviewed and approved by City Light. Customers work directly with an Energy Management Analyst. DLC certification required for all fixtures, retrofit kits, and NLC controls. 2026 incentive schedule published.

programs.stacking_rules: Rebates subject to availability of funds; may not exceed 70% of project costs
programs.program_notes_ai: Submit qualified purchases within 90 days of purchase date via online form. No pre-approval required. Covers connected thermostats, HVAC controls, lighting, and other eligible measures. Must be a Seattle City Light commercial customer.

programs.stacking_rules: Combined rebates cannot exceed total installed cost; one incentive per address for HVAC and hybrid heat pump water heaters
programs.program_notes_ai: Sales must occur after July 1 2025. Claims for 2025 sales must be submitted to distributor by end of February 2026. Installation address must be a current Seattle City Light customer. Covers heat pumps, HVAC, hybrid heat pump water heaters, VRF, chillers, pumps, fans.

programs.funding_status: Open — enhanced incentives Sept 1 through Dec 15 2025
programs.program_notes_ai: From September 1 through December 15 2025 SCL offered enhanced LTG incentives on select lamps, fixtures, and lighting controls — up to $800 per fixture. Ongoing commercial lighting midstream contract runs through 2026. Covers LED troffers, high bays, occupancy sensors.
Covers HVAC, water heating, lighting, commercial refrigeration, and motors. Download PDF application form from Avista website. Must be an Avista commercial electric customer in Washington.
Designed for grocery stores, supermarkets, and convenience stores. Grocer program agreement must be executed. Helps reduce energy use from commercial refrigeration systems.

programs.rebate_payment_method: Instant discount on invoice at service center
programs.program_notes_ai: Eligible motors: NEMA-rated, 15 hp to 5000 hp. Customer brings motor to participating Green Rewind service center. Instant discount of $1/hp applied to invoice. No paperwork required. Must be an Avista commercial electric customer.
Instant discount on invoice at qualifying distributors. No paperwork or waiting required. Wide variety of qualifying food service products.

programs.program_name: Avista Pay for Performance Program — Washington (2025)
programs.rebate_payment_method: Check — paid at end of each of 3 years
programs.program_notes_ai: Whole-building energy retrofits. Incentive paid at $0.08/kWh and $1.25/therm over 3 years with payments at end of each year. Savings must be measurable and verifiable. Download PDF application form from Avista website.

programs.stacking_rules: Does not apply to behavioral modifications
programs.program_notes_ai: Available for energy efficiency projects outside parameters of prescriptive programs with verifiable savings. Incentive based on first-year energy savings (kWh or therms). Does not apply to behavioral modifications.

Covers LED lighting and more for small and medium businesses. Changes effective Jan 1 2026 include updated small business non-lighting incentive tables. Call 1-855-805-7231 for questions. Separate agricultural/dairy program available.
Technical assistance and cash incentives for large commercial and industrial customers to save money, improve operations and achieve energy goals. Separate agricultural/dairy track also available.

BPA EEIM-aligned program. Midstream HVAC and Water Heating program paused for 2025. Lighting and other prescriptive measures remain available. Each utility runs its own enrollment process separate from other BPA-served utilities.

programs.program_name: Tacoma Power Business Energy Efficiency Rebates (2025)
programs.stacking_rules: Contractors must be registered separately with Tacoma Power; registration with other BPA utilities does not transfer
programs.program_notes_ai: BPA EEIM-aligned program. Heat pumps and water heater rebates available with income-qualified tiers. Contractor prequalification required; separate from other BPA-served utility registries.

programs.program_name: Clark Public Utilities Commercial Energy Efficiency Rebates (2025)
programs.stacking_rules: BPA EEIM-aligned; each utility runs separate enrollment; contractor registration not transferable from other BPA utilities
programs.program_notes_ai: BPA EEIM-aligned program serving Vancouver WA area (Clark County). Heat pump and weatherization rebates available. Each utility runs its own enrollment process and contractor registration separate from other BPA-served utilities.

rate_schedules.description: General Service under 50 kW; energy-only, no demand charge; secondary voltage
rate_schedules.notes: Rate per kWh shown is the upper tier (over 20,000 kWh); lower tier rates also apply. Effective Jan 29 2025 per Advice No. 2025-03.

rate_schedules.description: 50–350 kW demand; seasonal demand charges (Oct–Mar $13.16/kW, Apr–Sep $8.78/kW); secondary voltage
rate_schedules.notes: Demand charges are seasonal. Step 1 rates per GRC UE-240004. Reactive power charge applies at or above 100 kW.

rate_schedules.description: Demand greater than 350 kW; secondary or primary voltage; seasonal demand charges (Oct–Mar $16.27/kW, Apr–Sep $10.84/kW)
rate_schedules.notes: Step 1 rates effective Jan 29 2025 per GRC UE-240004. Step 2 (eff. Jan 29 2026): demand $21.63/kW Oct-Mar, $14.42/kW Apr-Sep; basic charge $436.32/mo. Reactive power charge $0.00169/kVArh.

rate_schedules.description: Master-metered residential/multifamily buildings; secondary or primary distribution voltage; no demand charge for first 50 kW or less of billing demand
rate_schedules.notes: Step 2 basic charge (eff. Jan 29 2026): $91.18. No demand charge for first 50 kW. Reactive power charge $0.00413/kVArh.

rate_schedules.description: Large C&I natural gas firm sales service (gas schedule, electric rate_per_kwh N/A)
rate_schedules.notes: Average rate approximately $1.38489/therm after Nov 2025 annual cost-of-gas adjustment (~3.20% decrease). Electric-only customers not subject to this schedule.
